Our process我們的流程

Five stages, each with an end.五個階段，每一個都有終點。

You always know which stage you are in and what it produces before it begins. You can stop after any of them.你永遠知道自己在哪個階段，以及開始之前就知道會拿到什麼。每一個階段結束後，你都可以停下來。

STAGE 0

Discovery初談

60 minutes · complimentary60 分鐘 · 不收費

Understand your questions, explain the scope of services, confirm mutual fit.了解你的問題、說明服務範圍、確認彼此適合。

STAGE 1

Financial Snapshot財務體檢

One-time engagement一次性服務

Data collection and verification. Six deliverables plus a 90-minute review.資料蒐集與查核。六項產出，含 90 分鐘檢視會談。

STAGE 2

Comprehensive Plan全面財務規劃

One-time engagement一次性服務

Full-module analysis. Written plan and implementation checklist, with one 90-day follow-up.全模組分析。書面規劃書與執行檢查表，含一次 90 天後追蹤。

STAGE 3

Ongoing Advisory持續顧問

Ongoing · quarterly持續 · 按季

Quarterly reviews, unlimited questions, implementation support, annual plan update.每季檢視、問題不限次數、執行支援、年度規劃更新。

STAGE 4

Asset Advisory資產顧問

Ongoing · Singapore only持續 · 僅限新加坡

Ongoing portfolio and retirement income management, provided through Blair Road Capital, an MAS-licensed fund management company.持續的投資組合與退休收入管理，透過 MAS 持牌基金管理公司 Blair Road Capital 提供。

Stage 3 begins once Stage 2 is complete.第三階段需先完成第二階段。

About關於

Fresco Su蘇佑成 Fresco Su

For twenty years I ran commercial businesses across Asia-Pacific, leading teams through market entries, restructurings, social unrest and a pandemic. That career taught me how money behaves under pressure, and how differently people decide when the money is their own. Since 2025 I have turned to what I care about most: helping like-minded people plan their finances so they can get on with living their lives.過去二十年，我在亞太市場經營商業業務，帶著團隊走過市場開拓、組織重整、社會動盪與一場疫情。那段職涯讓我看清錢在壓力下的樣子，也看清當賭注是自己的時候，人的判斷會有多不同。2025 年起，我轉向自己真正熱愛的事：陪伴理念相近的人把財務安排好，然後好好過生活。
